summary.text: Rob Stafsholt is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Senate representing District 10, based in New Richmond, elected to the Senate in 2020 after serving in the Assembly from 2016 to 2018.
He chairs the Committee on Financial Institutions and Sporting Heritage.

paragraphs.text: Stafsholt is a lifelong resident of St. Croix County, Wisconsin, and has one child.
He graduated from New Richmond Public Schools and attended the University of Wisconsin-Eau Claire and the University of Wisconsin-River Falls.

The Legislature's page lists him as a farmer and the owner of a waste disposal company and of a residential rental and real estate investment company, as well as a volunteer coach for the New Richmond-Somerset High School trap team.
He is a former co-owner of a salad and food dressings company and a former mortgage loan originator.

His listed memberships include the Farm Bureau, the New Richmond Chamber of Commerce and the National Rifle Association as a life member, and he chairs the Legislative Council Study Committee on Cryptocurrency.
